originalSummary: After you have completed the FRU replacement in a two-node MetroCluster configuration, you can perform the MetroCluster switchback operation. This returns the configuration to its normal operating state, with the sync-source storage virtual machines \(SVMs\) on the formerly impaired site now active and serving data from the local disk pools. The AFF A300 system supports only manual boot media recovery procedures.
fixedSummary: After completing the boot media replacement in a two-node MetroCluster configuration, perform the MetroCluster switchback operation to return the configuration to its normal operating state. The AFF A300 system supports only manual boot media recovery procedures.

originalSummary: Once environment variables are checked, you must complete steps specific to systems that have Onboard Key Manager \(OKM\), NetApp Storage Encryption \(NSE\) or NetApp Volume Encryption \(NVE\) enabled. The AFF A300 system supports only manual boot media recovery procedures.
fixedSummary: Restore encryption on the replacement boot media. Complete steps specific to systems that have Onboard Key Manager, NetApp Storage Encryption, or NetApp Volume Encryption enabled. The AFF A300 system supports only manual boot media recovery procedures.

originalSummary: The boot media stores a primary and secondary set of system \(boot image\) files that the system uses when it boots. The AFF A300 system supports only manual boot media recovery procedures. Automated boot media recovery is not supported. Depending on your network configuration, you can perform either a nondisruptive or disruptive replacement.
fixedSummary: The boot media stores a primary and secondary set of system files that the system uses when it boots. The AFF A300 system supports only manual boot media recovery procedures. Automated boot media recovery is not supported. Depending on your network configuration, you can perform either a nondisruptive or disruptive replacement.

originalSummary: You must replace a DIMM in the controller module when your system registers an increasing number of correctable error correction codes (ECC); failure to do so causes a system panic.
fixedSummary: Replace a DIMM in your AFF A300 controller module when the system registers an increasing number of correctable error correction codes or uncorrectable ECC errors. Failure to replace a faulty DIMM can cause a system panic.

originalSummary: You replace the real-time clock (RTC) battery in the controller module so that your system's services and applications that depend on accurate time synchronization continue to function.
fixedSummary: Replace the real-time clock battery in your AFF A300 controller module to ensure that services and applications that depend on accurate time synchronization continue to function.
